supersedes: Earlier source-only authorization boundary and3s transformation proposal; v1 assets remain preserved. Level Design relays explicit encounter implementation commission.

events.swarm_entry: v2/swarm-entry once; start v1/dispersed-loop for initial2s skitter.
events.rat_assembly: v2/insect-shriek once + v2/assembly once; crossfade to v1/formed-loop across2.5s assembly, never repeatedly emit shriek.
events.rat_pipe_hide: v2/swarm-entry reused intentionally as pipe retreat material cue; formed bed fades to dispersed at quiet gain.
events.pipe_warning: v2/pipe-warning2s; current helper centered, visible port warning remains required.
events.rat_phase_defeat: v2/rat-false-collapse once, fade bed to silence during4.5s apparent death; never canonical death/kill/reward/gate release.
events.reskitter: v1/dispersed-loop for4.5s, resume once and do not restart per frame.
events.alligator_assembly: v2/assembly reused2.5s; crossfade to formed bed; exact assembly timing remains implementation tuning.
events.alligator_jaw_warning: v1/alligator-warning reused; .9s proposed tell may cancel remaining .1s tail at attack start.
events.water_dive: v2/water-dive once; quiet dispersed bed while submerged, SFX only.
events.water_emerge: v2/water-emerge once; formed bed resumes by crossfade.
events.tail_warning: v2/tail-warning once per locked .8s throw warning; remaining cue tail canceled at release.
events.debris_release: v2/debris-release once per each of three sequential upward throws; cancel current tail warning at release.
events.debris_impact: v2/debris-impact, coalesce volley impacts with .10s cooldown and at most2voices.
events.hit: Existing v1/hit canonical nonlethal actual HP reduction; actor-local .12s cooldown. Phase-ending rat blow emits false collapse only.
events.terminal_death: Existing v1/death canonical once for terminal alligator defeat; stop every bed/warning/phase cue, tail may outlive actor.
events.cleanup: Stop all streams/clear event guards/cooldowns on reset/checkpoint/menu/dispose.
events.swim_start: Bed-only dispersed texture on alligator_swim and alligator_surface_swim entry; no splash replay or extra voice.
events.jaw_snap: v2/debris-release intentionally reused as dry roach-chitin jaw contact once per charge leg, after attack_start; two effects voices remain bounded.

asset_lookup: v1/ and v2/ names map to assets/audio/sfx/cockroach-swarm-v1|v2/<name>.wav; exact hashes/gains/durations in manifests.

limits.rapid_transition: Retarget existing two players from current gains; never allocate more.
limits.obsolete_warning: Cancel on phase change/death; never gate attacks on cue completion.

lifecycle.controls: Master/SFX mute applies; music-only mute independent. No queued catch-up events on unmute.
lifecycle.pause: Freeze stream positions, crossfade/duck envelopes and cooldowns.
lifecycle.cleanup: Reset/checkpoint/menu/dispose stops all and clears state; restore never replays prior events.
lifecycle.offscreen: PROPOSED positional attenuation, no offscreen attack initiation; already-fired cues may finish attenuated. Exact distance/culling pending.

mix: Warnings/shriek higher than low-level skitter; duck beds6dB during tells, phase/shriek1voice, warning1voice, effects2voices. Music-only mute never mutes creature audio. No final listening approval.
timing: All state timers owned by Mechanics/Engineering; audio completion never gates attacks, transformations or exit unlock. Pausing freezes playback and crossfades.

validation.source: PASS twelve reproducible v2cues; all20v1/v2header/frame/hash checks and original v1hash preservation.
validation.runtime: Focused headless helper suite passed; game wiring and packaged checks owned by Engineering.
validation.listening: No audition, mix and subjective clarity pending.

canonical: Keep existing hit/death block unchanged; auxiliary cues stay separate. Art owns metadata/catalog; Engineering owns runtime/build/roadmap.

runtime_helper.event_rule: Once per state entry; attack_start cancels obsolete warning; rat_assembly layers shriek plus assembly.
runtime_helper.limitations: Centered Master playback, no positional port pan/attenuation yet. Fixed warning duck has no smoothed envelope. Caller validates damage and owns state timing.

swim_charge_revision.ownership: Audio helper/test/handoff; Mechanics controller; Engineering room/build/roadmap.

reuse.intent: Original chitin contact supports jaw closure without literal animal voice; no new asset or provenance change.

swim_charge_revision.validation: Focused headless tests pass three swim/warn/release sequences, two jaw-warning/attack/snap legs, paused snap exclusion and existing pause/mute/death/reset bounds. Existing log permissions/macOS certificate diagnostics remain.
swim_charge_revision.listening: Not auditioned; directional pipe audio and subjective mix still pending.
